title: Kobold voxel game I'm making. Slowly coming together.
author: Dogbold
selftext:
Name is a placeholder. Done entirely with Claude Opus 5.5. All I did was say what I want.  
Expanding it to be as indepth as Minecraft and maybe a little more. I know there's probably a thousand vibe coded Minecraft clones but I wanted mine to be entirely based on the character being a kobold.

There's more biomes, like mountains, a swamp, desert, and some more cave types but there's no warp to them quite yet. I did reach a desert though.

https://i.redd.it/7a5j817h3svh1.png

Monsters also aren't in quite yet.   
There will also be more mechanics to make the surface not somewhere you want to be all the time, and different levels of sun goggles so you don't get the best most permanent ones right off the bat.  
  
I love the little treasure hoard pile Claude put next to the bed with a little dragon statue, very adorable. And I love how derpy the kobold looks.

There is meant to be some water physics but they aren't working quite right yet, as can be seen by the odd pillars shooting up out of the ground a few times. Water is supposed to drain from areas if you mine it so you can empty places out, but it seems that water on the surface is not generating in a carved out area, so it has no idea where to drain to and that's why it shoots up I think.

Might introduce an alchemical evolution type of system in the future that will give you bonuses but drawbacks, like increased dark vision, better resistance to surface and daytime effects, faster speed, and the ability to carry and use large weapons.

Also survival systems as well of course, food, health and all that.

I'm going to keep the style just like this, with this level of graphics because the more nuts you go the more Claude struggles to make it look good, and I kind of find this style cute anyway. It's playable in browser through Artifact or the html file. Might make an option to enhance graphics though, curious if Claude could get a lot better with this but keep it looking good and playable.

Definitely extremely super early, gotta polish stuff, like some weird leg glitches where he does little hoppies instead of running (though this is cute), spines floating off the back of his head, the water glitch, the chests not having their top rendered on one side, etc. Might polish the model more too just so he looks like a full thing and not parts that work together.  
There is a character creator with different scale colors, horns, snout shape, tail type and such but it's in the backend and not finished yet.

Idk, would people be interested in playing this once it's all polished? Do you think the graphics are far too simple? Should I get some nice textures going? Polish up the voxel more?

comments.author: Dogbold
comments.body: Oh... ok then. Well I guess it does honestly look like and play like shit. Maybe I shouldn't have started, I doubt it will get any better than this.

replies.author: TheBigQuestion354
replies.body: just some constructive feedback, Claude is good for coding and some assets but things like character models should be made using programs like Tripo.

replies.author: Dogbold
replies.body: I'm subbed to Tripo I guess I can see what it will put out
